questions.question: In the Beatitudes, who does Jesus say will inherit the earth?
Jesus said he did not come to destroy the law, but to do what?
Jesus taught that you should love your neighbors but hate your enemies.
You are the _____ of the world. A city located on a hill can't be hidden.
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of _____.
Why does Jesus tell His disciples to let their light shine before men?
options: So that men will know they are wise
So that men will honor and praise them
So that men may see their good deeds and glorify their Father in heaven
So that men will be ashamed of their own darkness
questions.answer: So that men may see their good deeds and glorify their Father in heaven
